story.iWant: I want to import master data (customers, suppliers, bank accounts, opening balances) from standardized Excel/CSV templates with validations and audit trail
story.soThat: so that onboarding and cut-over can be executed safely, efficiently, and with full data integrity

criterion.title: Templates & Upload
criterion.detail: Only sanctioned Excel/CSV templates are accepted with file type and header validation.
Invalid templates or headers are rejected with actionable error messaging.

criterion.title: Pre-Validation & Preview
criterion.detail: Client- and server-side validation runs before commit, showing row-level errors and counts for inserted, skipped, and error rows.
Users can download an error report (CSV) listing row number, field, and message.

criterion.title: Transactional Integrity
criterion.detail: Each import operation commits atomically; any error results in no partial writes.
Opening balance import enforces Dr = Cr and blocks posting when the first period is already closed.

criterion.title: Multi-Tenancy & Security
criterion.detail: All writes are company-scoped via CompanyContext with no cross-company leakage.
RBAC restricts imports to ADMIN or CHIEF_ACCOUNTANT roles.

criterion.title: Audit Trail
criterion.detail: Import attempts log inserted, skipped, and error counts plus per-row audit entries capturing payload changes.

criterion.title: Performance & UX
criterion.detail: Validate and import up to 1,000 rows within 30 seconds, noting strategy for larger sets.
Progress feedback is shown during long-running operations with localized messages supporting English and Vietnamese.

criterion.title: Architecture & Tech Alignment
criterion.detail: Backend follows Spring Boot layering with company scoping and Apache POI for spreadsheets.
Frontend uses feature-first structure under @/features/accounting with shadcn UI and Zod validation.

criterion.title: Demo Data Compatibility
criterion.detail: Provide import-ready demo datasets aligned with the seeded demo company.
Demo templates validate without manual editing and document required relationships.

constraints.item: Multi-tenancy: all imports must set and respect CompanyContext; reject requests without X-Company-Id
RBAC: restrict import endpoints to ADMIN and CHIEF_ACCOUNTANT roles; enforce via @PreAuthorize and integration tests
Transactional integrity: imports execute within a single transaction with rollback on first failure; no partial data writes
Opening balances: enforce Dr = Cr, explicitly block imports if first period is closed, and surface actionable error messages
Validation: server ensures template type, headers, and data types match sanctioned schemas; return row-level error payloads plus downloadable CSV report
Audit trail: log attempt metadata (success/error counts, user id, IP, user agent) and per-row audit entries for traceability
Performance: baseline 1,000-row import in ≤30s; provide progress indicator and guidance for background strategy on larger files
Localization: all UI copy and error messaging must support English and Vietnamese with existing i18n bundle
Demo data: maintain validated sample templates aligned with seeded demo company and document dependencies
